name: Terraced Cliff Generation
definition: Generates a terraced cliff geometry and physics colliders for a run from a start point to an end point, creating stepped strata rising outward, meshed as coarse voxels, and backed by merged fixed cuboid colliders.
summary: Terraced Cliff Generation creates stepped 3D terrain meshes for linear runs using coarse voxel discretization and fixed cuboid colliders, differing from general procedural terrain by focusing specifically on boundary edges.
